summary: The chapter adheres strictly to the plan, research sources, and guide context. It thoroughly covers maintaining the supplier quality system, auditing external provider workflows against ISO 9001 requirements with historical edition context, evaluating operational indicators without speculative ROI formulas, answering assigned implementation and compliance questions, and conducting scripted software demonstrations. Pending capabilities such as supplier portals and automated APQP/PPAP tracking are properly framed as items to verify live, human-in-the-loop controls over automated suggestions are reinforced, and all hypothetical examples are explicitly labeled.
